blocks.text: LONDON, United Kingdom — The brother of Princess Diana, Charles Spencer, on Sunday accused King Charles III of “gaslighting” him by questioning his explosive account of events surrounding her death in an upcoming memoir. Spencer, whose book about his older sister, “Swan Song,” comes out Tuesday, told the Mail on Sunday newspaper: “It is not every day you wake up to find you’ve been gaslit by the King,” escalating a war of words after Buckingham Palace issued a rare statement. A Palace spokesperson reacted to the memoir’s claims Thursday, saying the 77-year-old king “is mindful that the pain of fraternal grief […]...
